Name: Penny Revised - Seasonal - SO Matching Sprites
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
A small optional mod for ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9916]Penny Revised[/url] (seasonal) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9890]Penny Revised[/url] (non-seasonal) by stanloona420 and that takes two of the sprites and makes them "no nose" and has the feet standing together, to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url] aesthetic.

In my game, I use the yellow Penny Revised for Spring, the winter seasonal Penny Revised for Winter, and use the Seasonal Outfits versions for Summer and Fall. So, my files are named accordingly, but just change the season if you like.

For the yellow outfit, I did the hair mostly on my own as it's the one I use now, so it is a bit straighter compared to the stanloona sprites I
copied in the Red version.

Check Penny Revised for installation method and further details. Mod uploaded with permission.

Downloads.Description: New Yellow Shirt version, more faithful to the original Penny.
